verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents a quickstart that completes a minimal end-to-end online payment in the sandbox using Airwallex.js and the hosted payment page. It is backed by instant self-serve sandbox signup, low-code Hosted Payment Page and Drop-in Element options with createElement usage, AI-agent integration notes, and an airwallex-dev skill that generates integration code. That supports a fast first payment flow, but the evidence shows only JavaScript client-side usage, with no copy-paste examples in multiple languages or server SDKs. missing for 10: evidence of copy-paste code samples across multiple languages/server SDKs, independent or hands-on corroboration of under-a-day time-to-first-payment.
